scope: Real RTX4060 CUDA streams/events, pinned D2H/H2D and native Mooncake TCP; actual Qwen FlashInfer RemoteDrop and DSV sparse kernels. Native PD prealloc, ReqKvInfo, request-row pool and paged allocator source loaded, including real CUDA alloc_extend Triton kernels for page 4/16. Small model/scheduler/admission fixtures; no checkpoint weights, production SMG, H20 TP4/RDMA or throughput acceptance.

qwen.scope: Real Qwen layer-group x token-range transport; no model-weight claim.

qwen_native_reservation.scope: Real native paged allocator kernels and PD preallocation on small Qwen pools.

dsv.scope:
D2D commands + native state bytes + actual GPU Remote during blocked KV copy.

Small pools and scheduler/allocator ABI fixtures; no model weights, SM100
FlashMLA, native HTTP stream rerouting, or H20 RDMA performance claim.

dsv_independent_entry_local.scope: Group-layer CUDA probes; real transport/kernels, explicit scheduler ABI fixtures.

faults.scope:
D2D safety regressions: real CUDA/TE, injected faults, no model weights.

A lost connection must retain the receive slot without retrying; an unproven
D2H must retain its GPU input. Both cases assert safety after writing the report.
The retry probe never submits a deliberately stale destination pointer to TE.

result.target_error: ConnectionError('injected connection loss before bulk completion')
